card.title: Director of Operations - Chillers
card.description:
Backed by more than a century of engineering excellence in thermal management technology, Modexus Solutions has sharpened its focus as a specialized leader in commercial HVAC and data center solutions into a new era. Throughout this evolution, our dynamic and collaborative culture, driven by our talented people, has propelled us to the forefront of the industry on a new frontier. At Modexus Solutions, we foster an environment of entrepreneurship and ingenuity, empowering our team to continually drive innovation. Joining Modexus Solutions means unlocking meaningful career growth, continuous development, and high-impact opportunities.

The answer is clear: your next opportunity starts here. Transform the future with us.

For more information about Modexus Solutions, visit www.modexussolutions.com

**Position Description**
------------------------

This role represents a critical executive leadership opportunity for a dynamic Director of Operations – Chillers to join the Global Operations team. Reporting directly to the VP of Global Operations with a dotted-line relationship to the Vice President & General Manager (VPGM) of the Chillers business unit, this leader has direct operational responsibility for all global chiller manufacturing plants.

Each global chiller facility holds full SQDC (Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost) execution accountability. To drive self-sufficient, world-class execution at the plant level, the Director of Operations – Chillers will lead a comprehensive, multi-functional organization where each plant team includes dedicated Safety, Quality, Materials, and Manufacturing Operations resources.

As an integral member of the Global Operations team, this individual operates as an influential peer to Supply Chain (partnering to enable global Supply Chain and SIOP execution) and Materials (partnering to enable Materials management and Localized Procurement strategies), as well as the broader Global Operations leadership team. By bridging global functional capabilities with plant-level execution and business unit strategy, the Director of Operations – Chillers will drive rapid operational transformation, capacity expansion, and sustainable business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Global Plant Leadership & SQDC Execution Accountability**

* Hold direct operational oversight and P&L/conversion cost accountability for all global chiller manufacturing facilities.
* Drive rigorousSQDC (Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost) daily management and execution across every chiller site:

* **Safety:** Champion a zero-injury culture, ensuring proactive EHS compliance, ergonomic improvements, and behavioral safety leadership across all plants.
* **Quality:** Ensure zero-defect manufacturing standards, robust quality management systems, customer compliance, and rapid root-cause corrective actions.
* **Delivery:** Achieve industry-leading on-time delivery (OTD) and lead-time competitiveness through effective line balancing, capacity tracking, and constraint management.
* **Cost:** Optimize direct and indirect labor productivity, overhead absorption, scrap reduction, and continuous conversion cost improvements.

### **2. Multi-Functional Team Management & Talent Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop Plant Managers and site leadership teams across the global chiller footprint.
* Ensure each plant's respective organization is effectively structured and resourced across Safety, Quality, Materials, and Manufacturing Operations to deliver autonomous day-to-day SQDC execution.
* Build organizational capability, establish clear succession plans, and foster an empowered, high-accountability, results-oriented culture across both salaried and direct labor workforces.

**Job Responsibilities Continued**
----------------------------------

**3. Matrixed & Peer Collaboration**

* **Business Unit Alignment (Dotted Line to VPGM of Chillers):** Serve as a strategic operational partner to the VPGM of Chillers, translating commercial growth strategies, customer requirements, and new product introductions (NPI) into scalable manufacturing execution plans.
* **Supply Chain & SIOP Partnership (Peer to Supply Chain):** Collaborate closely with Supply Chain and the Supply Chain/SIOP organization to align long-term capacity planning, master production scheduling, demand-supply balancing, and headcount/capacity models.
* **Materials & Localized Procurement Partnership (Peer to Materials):** Partner closely with Materials and the Materials/Procurement organization to optimize plant-level material flow, inventory turns, working capital, supplier quality/delivery performance, and localized sourcing strategies.
* **Global Operations Synergy:** Collaborate with fellow peers on the Global Operations leadership team to standardize best practices, leverage shared subassembly/hub strategies, and drive enterprise-wide operational initiatives.

### **4. Operational Excellence, Footprint Strategy & Continuous Improvement**

* Define and execute the end-to-end global manufacturing strategy for the Chillers business, aligning footprint optimization, capital investments (CapEx), and automation roadmaps with long-term growth targets.
* Embed Lean manufacturing principles, 80/20 simplification, value-stream mapping, and continuous improvement methodologies across all global chiller sites.
* Support modular design integration, subassembly standardization, and agile manufacturing practices in partnership with Advanced Manufacturing Engineering and Design Engineering.

**Required Education & Qualifications**
---------------------------------------

* **Bachelor’s degree** in Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related technical discipline is required.
* **10+ years** of progressive experience in manufacturing and operations leadership roles (e.g., Plant Manager, Senior Operations Manager, Director of Operations) within complex, engineered-to-order or configure-to-order industrial/HVAC manufacturing environments.
* **5+ years** of proven experience leading multi-site / global manufacturing operations, demonstrating measurable improvements in SQDC metrics.
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional plant organizations encompassing Safety, Quality, Materials, and Manufacturing Operations.
* Deep functional knowledge of Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, 80/20 principles, Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning (SIOP), material replenishment systems, and localized procurement interfaces.
* Proven ability to thrive in a matrixed organizational structure, effectively balancing solid-line functional excellence (to the VP, Global Operations) with dotted-line commercial business unit alignment (to the VPGM of Chillers).
* Exceptional executive presence, communication, and interpersonal influencing skills, with a collaborative approach to working with peer leaders across Supply Chain, Materials, Engineering, and Finance.
* Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally (up to 30%–50% depending on home base location) to support global chiller manufacturing plants.

**Why Choose Modexus Solutions?**

**Health & Well-being:**

* Competitive Health, Dental & Vision Insurance Coverage **on Day One!**
* Additional Benefits After 90 days of Continuous Employment
 + 8 weeks of short term disability leave paid at 100%
 + 4 weeks of paid parental leave paid at 100%
 + Maternity Leave (12 weeks at 100% pay)
 + Paternity Leave (4 weeks at 100% pay)

**Financial Benefits:**

* 401k Retirement plan and company match
* Life Insurance
* Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Short Term Disability (company paid)
* Long Term Disability

card.title: Director of Virtual Operations
card.description:
We save lives while providing the opportunity for people to realize their healthy selves.:

**Director of Virtual Operations**

**Monte Nido**

**Remote**

Monte Nido has been delivering treatment for eating disorders for over three decades. Our programs offer a model of treatment that blends medically sophisticated care with a personalized treatment approach. Our work is grounded in evidence-based strategies for adults and adolescents suffering from eating disorders. We work from a multi-disciplinary treatment team approach while integrating state-of-the-art medical, psychiatric, nutritional, and clinical strategies to provide comprehensive care within an intimate home setting.

The Director of Virtual Operations provides strategic and operational leadership for Monte Nido’s virtual programs in accordance with the organization’s philosophy and mission. Reporting to the Vice President of Virtual Programs, the Director leads the Program Manager and Group Facilitation Senior Manager, establishes consistent operating standards, and ensures effective coordination across program operations, group facilitation, clinical leadership, quality, compliance, and support functions. The role is accountable for staffing and capacity planning, scheduling and coverage, attendance and census processes, documentation and clinical quality oversight, regulatory readiness, performance measurement, process improvement, and resolution of escalated operational and safety concerns. The Director translates organizational priorities into reliable execution, develops leaders, uses data to identify risks and opportunities, and advances safe, high-quality, efficient virtual care.

Schedule: Monday-Friday

Salary: $70k-$85k annually

Total Rewards::

Discover a rewarding career with us and enjoy an array of comprehensive benefits! We prioritize your success and well-being, providing:

* Competitive compensation
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage (Benefits At a Glance)
* Retirement
* Company-paid life insurance, AD&D, and short-term disability
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* Paid time off
* Professional development
* And many more!

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Responsibilities Include::

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** 
1. Provide strategic and operational leadership for virtual program operations, translating organizational priorities into clear plans, standards, and measurable outcomes. 
2. Lead, coach, and supervise the Program Manager/Coordinator and Group Facilitation Senior Manager, including goal setting, performance management, career development, succession planning, and corrective action when needed. 
3. Establish operating expectations across program administration and group facilitation, ensuring leaders maintain consistent practices for staffing, scheduling, coverage, attendance, documentation, client engagement, and escalation. 
4. Maintain oversight of staffing models, schedules, capacity, and coverage across virtual programs; anticipate resource needs and escalate material risks with clear recommendations. 
5. Own program schedules across virtual services, including schedule design, maintenance, and communication; identify availability limitations and escalate constraints that may affect access, coverage, or continuity of care to Clinical Directors and other appropriate clinical leaders. 
6. Oversee attendance, census, engagement, discharge, outcomes, client satisfaction, and operational performance indicators; use trends to improve retention, quality, and efficiency. 
7. Ensure reliable documentation and clinical quality audit processes, including timely corrective follow-up, retraining, chart completion, required signatures, and maintenance of program records. 
8. Direct operational readiness for Joint Commission, payer, licensing, and internal audits in partnership with clinical, quality, compliance, billing, and human resources leaders. 
9. Ensure virtual-program policies, procedures, care schedules, handbooks, workflows, and telehealth standards remain current, practical, and consistently implemented. 
10. Partner with clinical and medical leaders to resolve escalated client safety, attendance, staffing, documentation, and program-quality concerns while preserving appropriate clinical decision-making authority. 
11. Partner with Clinical Directors to develop and implement quality-of-care initiatives, monitor effectiveness, address identified gaps, and support consistent standards across virtual programs. 
12. Define performance expectations for operational functions and hold leaders accountable for employee development, engagement, conduct, productivity, and consistent application of policies in partnership with Human Resources. 
13. Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve workflows, technology use, communication, service quality, and the experience of clients, families, employees, and referral partners. 
14. Communicate significant operational, safety, quality, compliance, and resource risks to the Vice President of Virtual Programs with timely analysis and recommended actions. 
15. Represent virtual operations in required leadership and management meetings and facilitate decision-making, implementation, and follow-through across stakeholder groups.

**Additional Duties and Responsibilities** 
1. Support insurance, compliance, personnel-file, referral-partner, outpatient-provider, and discharge-transition activities when operational leadership is needed. 
2. Provide executive-ready updates on virtual program performance, risks, priorities, and improvement initiatives. 
3. Maintain professionalism, confidentiality, sound judgment, and respectful communication in all interactions. 
4. Adhere to Monte Nido & Affiliates policies, procedures, telehealth etiquette, and safety standards, and ensure assigned leaders reinforce them consistently. 
5. Provide additional operational leadership and complete other duties as assigned. 
6. VIRTUAL EMPLOYEES: We have the same expectations for employees as we do for Cares. We ask that you keep your camera on and join from a private space free of noise and distractions (e.g., not from a car) when meeting with Cares or joining a clinical staff meeting. You will need a reliable video conferencing setup, including a camera, microphone, and stable, high-speed Internet connection. You must also be prepared with a backup plan in the event of technology failures. We expect you to consider your personal appearance in much the same way you would when seeing Cares in person. You must also keep your background clean and professional.

Qualifications::

* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, behavioral health, business, or a related field required; master’s degree preferred. An equivalent combination of education and directly relevant leadership experience may be considered.
* Five or more years of progressively responsible experience in behavioral health, healthcare operations, or a comparable care-delivery environment, including at least three years of people leadership. Experience leading managers, overseeing virtual operations, managing multi-program workflows, and supporting accreditation, payer, and regulatory requirements is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop managers, establish clear expectations, and drive accountability across multiple programs and functions
* Strong operational judgment, change leadership, project management, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to interpret operational and quality data, identify trends, manage risk, and implement sustainable improvements.
* Knowledge of Joint Commission standards, payer requirements, patient confidentiality laws, telehealth requirements, and organizational compliance expectations.

You must also keep your background clean and professional.

* Five or more years of progressively responsible experience in behavioral health, healthcare operations, or a comparable care-delivery environment, including at least three years of people leadership. Experience leading managers, overseeing virtual operations, managing multi-program workflows, and supporting accreditation, payer, and regulatory requirements is strongly preferred.

* Strong operational judgment, change leadership, project management, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to interpret operational and quality data, identify trends, manage risk, and implement sustainable improvements.
* Knowledge of Joint Commission standards, payer requirements, patient confidentiality laws, telehealth requirements, and organizational compliance expectations.

card.description:
**The Team:** 
The Hermès Palm Beach Boutique opened in 1977 and focuses on providing extraordinary service to clients as a part of the Southern Region. This position will report to the Managing Director and will work collaboratively with the sales team and selling support teams to support the client experience in a fast-paced, luxury environment.

**The Opportunity:** 
The Operations Director is responsible for overseeing all operational functions which may include inventory control, housekeeping, maintenance and selling service associates. This position is responsible for adhering to P&L budget for all operational areas. The Director of Operations communicates trains and implements all company policies and ensures compliance. The Operations Director will create efficient processes, set parameters and implement directives to support operational efficiency and growth.

All other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

**About the Role:**

* Manages shipping and receiving department. Assess actions to be taken with receiving issues. Ensure the timely movement of merchandise and adherence to all procedural guidelines including but not limited to transfers, RTVs, damages, negative on hands etc. Through management of inventory control associates and other operational staff, ensure the organization and efficient operation of all back of house space.
* Takes part in all managerial responsibilities for efficient running of the business inclusive of overseeing and validating cash handling procedures are respected, appropriately documented and reported to Managing Director. Operations Director will contribute and work in tandem with retail management team as needed and in fair rotation. Operations Director will also assist in the absence of Managing Director and Floor Directors during Podium, vacations or in the absence of the Assistant Manager or Selling Supervisor.
* Ensure workflow of all after-sales service and craftspeople/tailors if applicable.
* Performs and prepares for all inventories and cycle counts, including reconciliations of stock discrepancies. Performs stock adjustments.
* Liaison with corporate construction and maintenance department and outside vendors with regards to any maintenance needs. Ensure building and store are maintained to company standard and all issues are addressed in a timely manner.
* Ensure functionality of all IT and phone system by communicating with corporate contacts and securing resolutions.
* Acts as a liaison with outside vendors for monthly need and or special events.
* Partners with Managing Director to manage operational team and vendors ensuring appropriate scheduling training and coaching. Manages E-time and keeps accurate record of vacation and time and attendance with HR. This includes all SSA’s, housekeeping, shipping and receiving, asset protection guards and after sales staff as appropriate for the location.
* Coordinates and prepares evacuation drills and provides training to team with regards to emergency response preparedness.
* Responsible for and oversees all operations and after-sales supply orders.
* Oversees all Staff Sales
* Trains staffs to ensure compliance with all operational policies and procedures ensuring policies are thoroughly communicated to all staff in a timely manner.
Recruits and maintains an active talent bank for any operational positions. 

**Supervisory Responsibility:**

* YES

Supervises Inventory Control, SSA and After-Sales positions. (Tailor, Maintenance, Crafts persons)

**Budget Responsibility:**

* YES

Budget guidelines are set annually. The Operations Director will be directly involved with budget expectations with regards to selling supplies, cleaning and maintenance contracts, guard service, repairs, rental equipment and kitchen supplies. They will work within the confines of the budget in partnership with the respective corporate departments. The Operations Director should identify areas for cost efficient and minimize costs when possible.

**Decision Making Responsibility:**

* YES

Assess when general repairs need to be made to the building and when electronic equipment should be upgraded or replaced in partnership with corporate offices. Determine actions to be taken when receiving issues with negative on hands. Responsible for deciding when supply orders need to be placed. Implement efficient workflow processes for after-sales tracking.

**About You:**

* 5+ years of retail management experience in a similar role; prior experience in a luxury environment preferred.
* Proficient shipping and receiving experience.
* Excellent computer skills and proficient in MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
* Excellent communication skills both verbal and written.
* Strong POS and phone systems knowledge.
* Extensive building maintenance experience.
* Must work well under pressure and have the ability to multi-task with accuracy.
* Acute interpersonal skills and a collaborative management style.
* Familiarity with international parent companies a plus.
Ability to lift between 0-25 lbs. without assistance. 

The range for this position is $99,155.47 - $120,000.00 annually. Actual rates are determined based on the job, location, and individual experience.

Hermès is proud to offer a variety of benefits to support the needs of our employees and their families, including:

* Commission and bonus incentives based on sales performance
* Medical, Dental, Vision
* Life Insurance and Disability
* Paid time off (annual vacation of 15 days, 11 company holidays, 3 floating holidays, 2 wellbeing days, and sick & safe time)
* Paid Parental leave and transition time
* 401(k) and Roth Retirement plan with company matching and profit sharing
* Various voluntary benefits such as flexible spending accounts, fitness reimbursement, voluntary life insurance
* Product discount and EAP resources
Access to Calm App, Health Advocate, Family Building Support and more! 

We are looking for a candidate that has a combination of the above attributes and can perform the key functions of the role with or without reasonable accommodations.

**Company Overview** 
Since 1837, Hermès has remained faithful to its artisan business model and humanist values. We place people at the heart of what we do and aspire to make a positive impact on the world. The freedom to create, the constant search for beautiful materials, the transmission of a savoir-faire of excellence and the aesthetic of functionality define the singularity of Hermès, a house dedicated to making highly-crafted, beautiful objects made to stand the test of time.

An independent, family-owned company, Hermès is dedicated to keeping production in France through its 42 workshops, The Hermès organization is also a truly global community with a network of 310 stores in 49 countries. Hermès employs more than 15,000 people worldwide with over 6,000 of the workforce being Hermès craftspeople engaged in making artisanal products, nurturing a 180+ year tradition of creativity and innovation.

At Hermès, our actions for sustainable development and corporate social responsibility are founded in values passed down by generations of humble artisans who have shaped the story of our house and the integrity of our objects. The roots of Hermès’ success and longevity lie in a sense of responsibility; a quest for authenticity and respect for time and preservation of natural resources. All at Hermès wish to leave a positive footprint on the world, a mission that’s at the heart of our commitment to progress. This narrative can be experienced in a series of shorts films “Footsteps Across the World” available on our website. Link here .

**Our Commitment** 
Family is at the heart of Hermès. At Hermès of Paris, we are committed to being a Maison for All, a home where we make efforts to generate, support and advance the values of diversity, inclusion and family both within our own walls and in the wider world. At Hermès of Paris we look to create a diverse workforce of talented and unique individuals with different backgrounds, skillsets and worldviews that will enrich our Hermès of Paris family. We support our individual team members personal and professional success through a culture that values equality, individuality and fairness and through an environment where individuals can thrive and feel comfortable being their authentic selves. Beyond the walls of our Maison, we advance our DIF values through the work that we do in partnership with our community and non-profit partners.

Applicants are recruited, selected and hired without discrimination because of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, citizenship, military or veteran status or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. In addition, personnel procedures and practices with regard to training, promotion, transfer, compensation, demotion, lay off or termination are to be administered with due regard to job performance, experience and qualifications, but without discrimination because of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, citizenship, military or veteran status or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. Hermès of Paris, Inc. also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, in accordance with applicable laws.

**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

This Managing Director role, Global Head of Custody Operations and NAM Lead for Investor Services Operations, is a senior leadership position within the Investor Services Operations leadership team, reporting within Services Operations.

The role provides global strategic accountability for Citi's Custody Operations franchise and senior leadership accountability for North America (NAM) Investor Services Operations, including institutional governance, regulatory compliance, and market-leading asset safety across multi-trillion-dollar traditional and emerging asset portfolios.

The successful candidate will set the strategic vision and deliver the multi-year transformation roadmap across Citi's Custody franchise, spanning international branch operations and shared service hubs, while leading an international workforce of approximately 1,700 professionals across more than 60 countries. This includes oversight of the global operating model, direct custody market access, sub-custody networks, and core post-trade infrastructure

This executive will drive operational excellence, regulatory compliance, risk management, client experience, and strategic transformation through the modernization of core platforms, the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and intelligent automation, and the development of digital asset custody readiness.

The role requires close partnership with Technology, Product Management, Sales, Markets, Risk, Legal, Audit, and business leadership to ensure Citi maintains a best-in-class custody control environment and resilient investor services infrastructure while supporting commercial growth. The position demands significant experience leading large-scale global operations organizations within highly regulated environments and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across businesses, functions, geographies, regulators, and industry bodies.

 
 

**Responsibilities**

**Strategic & Operational Leadership:**

 
 

* Lead the Custody Operations organization, delivering operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and strong client outcomes.
* Provide senior leadership and oversight for NAM Investor Services Operations, ensuring resilient, timely, and effective execution across critical custody and investor servicing activities.
* Architect and execute the global Target Operating Model (TOM), strategically balancing scale across centralized multi-hub Centers of Excellence with direct custody market access across 60+ countries.
* Define and execute the strategic vision for Custody Operations and NAM Investor Services Operations, aligning operational priorities with Citi's business, risk, client, and regulatory objectives.
* Drive transformation initiatives that improve effectiveness, scalability, resilience, productivity, and service quality.
* Sponsor enterprise post-trade technology investments, steering legacy platform rationalization and the transition to cloud-native, API-first, and event-driven market connectivity.
* Partner across Operations, Technology, Product, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Audit, and business leadership to deliver strategic priorities and enterprise objectives.

**Custody Operations:**

* Maintain end-to-end accountability for Custody operations, including settlement, asset servicing, income processing, and related operational activities across traditional and emerging asset classes.
* Ensure effective execution of custody controls across sub-custody networks, direct market access arrangements, and shared service hubs.
* Drive enhancements to processing effectiveness, data quality, platform modernization, and operational intelligence.
* Ensure custody operations remain responsive to changing regulatory requirements, market infrastructure developments, and emerging industry risks.
* Support new products, client implementations, strategic initiatives, and acquisitions through effective custody risk assessment and operational readiness.
* Partner with Product and Innovation teams to build future-ready operational infrastructure bridging traditional securities with digital and tokenized assets.

**North America Investor Services Operations**

* Provide leadership oversight of critical North America investor services and custody operations, ensuring settlement excellence, operational resilience, and effective risk management.
* Maintain strong operational governance and First Line of Defense accountability across NAM Investor Services Operations, including effective management of operational, asset protection, and resilience risks.
* Maintain readiness for regulatory supervision and engagement across relevant North American authorities.
* Drive the continued modernization of the NAM investor services environment, including automation and AI across exception management, reconciliations, and technology co-design.
* Partner closely with Custody Product, Sales, and Markets leadership to accelerate commercial growth and alignment with client priorities.
* Maintain a strong focus on execution and client outcomes, including service quality, settlement performance, exception management, operational resilience, and the management of material incidents.

**Risk, Governance & Regulatory Management**

 
 

* Maintain robust operational controls, procedures, and governance frameworks consistent with Citi policy, regulatory expectations, and enterprise risk standards, including the Manager's Control Assessment (MCA) framework.
* Enforce strict client asset segregation, cross-border custody tax governance, and global regulatory compliance.
* Maintain strong First Line ownership of operational and control risks across both Custody Operations and NAM Investor Services Operations.
* Represent the organization during regulatory examinations, audits, independent reviews, and risk assessments.
* Ensure timely remediation of audit findings, regulatory issues, and control weaknesses.
* Establish proactive risk mitigation, institutional business continuity (BCP), and cross-regional failover capabilities to ensure uninterrupted market access under severe market dislocation.
* Exercise sound judgment and reinforce a culture of accountability, compliance, and ethical decision-making.

**Client Experience & Innovation**

 
 

* Deliver a client-centric operating model that balances robust custody controls with efficient and predictable client experiences.
* Champion modernization of custody processing, asset servicing, exception management, and reconciliation workflows.
* Drive enterprise productivity through the deployment of Artificial Intelligence (Machine Learning, GenAI, and predictive exception models) and intelligent automation to decouple volume growth from cost trajectory.
* Advance digital asset custody readiness, including tokenized securities, smart contract lifecycle models, and digital asset safekeeping and key management, alongside traditional custody architecture.
* Partner with Technology, Product, and Compliance teams to co-design and implement next-generation solutions supporting custody risk management, platform modernization, operational resilience, and improved client outcomes.

**People Leadership & Talent Development:**

 

* Lead, mentor, and inspire a diverse, high-performing global organization of approximately 1,700 professionals across Custody Operations and senior NAM Investor Services Operations leadership.
* Create a culture focused on accountability, inclusion, continuous improvement, employee engagement, and talent development.
* Establish strong executive succession pipelines and maintain accountability for organizational design, workforce strategy, budget management, and performance outcomes.
* Foster operational excellence and strong risk awareness across all levels of the organization.
* As a member of the Investor Services Operations leadership team, contribute to the strategic direction of the broader Services Operations organization.
* Build strong partnerships across internal stakeholders and external industry, regulatory, client, and technology partners.

**Required Experience & Competencies****:**

 
 

* Extensive and progressive senior executive leadership in Securities Services, Custody, Investor Operations, or Post-Trade Market Infrastructure within a Tier-1 global financial institution.
* Proven track record directing large-scale, matrixed international operations across multiple regions and time zones.
* Demonstrated success architecting and delivering large-scale operational transformations, Target Operating Model (TOM) redesigns, and core technology modernizations.
* Deep expertise in global transaction lifecycles, sub-custody networks, asset servicing, custody tax frameworks, and international asset protection regulations.
* Strong First Line risk and controls experience, including familiarity with the supervisory expectations of relevant regulatory authorities.
* Proven track record leading large-scale transformation, automation, digitization, and operational excellence initiatives.
 

 

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Track record of sponsoring Artificial Intelligence (GenAI/ML), predictive analytics, and cognitive workflow automation within institutional post-trade operations.
* Working knowledge of Digital Asset Custody, including tokenized securities, smart contract lifecycle models, and digital asset safekeeping/key management, alongside traditional custody architecture.
* Experience representing a major financial institution with custody industry bodies, market infrastructure providers, regulators, and institutional clients.
* Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills with the ability to drive alignment across senior executive audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to lead effectively within highly regulated, global, and matrixed organizations

**Senior Manager, Operations External Manufacturing**

**About the Company:**

At Horizon Organic, we’re growing a culture of passionate people driven to do good for the horizon we all share. We’re building the tomorrow we want to see. Every single day.

Joining our team means being part of a dynamic environment where your skills are valued, and your contributions make a real difference. We offer diverse opportunities for career growth and development. Embark on a rewarding journey with us in shaping the future of organic dairy!

Two generations of families—and counting—have grown up on Horizon Organic® milk. From the start, as the leading organic milk producer in the U.S., Horizon has been committed to delivering innovative, nourishing dairy that growing families can rely on. In 2023, Horizon Organic became a brand of Platinum Equity. Today, Horizon works with more than 500 farmers across the U.S. to bring high-quality, certified organic milk to consumers. For more information on Horizon’s full portfolio of organic dairy products, visit Horizon.com.

**About the Job:**

We are currently looking to hire a **Senior Manager, Operations External Manufacturing** to join our Supply Chain Department.

Leads external manufacturing operations and network optimization activities across contract manufacturing partners. This role is responsible for ensuring external manufacturing partners deliver excellence in Safety, Quality, Cost, and Delivery while supporting business growth, supply continuity, and operational effectiveness. The position partners closely with Procurement, PMO, Quality, R&D, Finance, Brand, Planning, Logistics, Customer Experience, and Milk Procurement teams to drive execution and continuous improvement across the external manufacturing network.

The Senior Manager - Operations External Manufacturing is responsible for the operational leadership of external manufacturing partners, management of manufacturing qualifications, execution of network optimization initiatives, and oversight of manufacturing performance across assigned facilities. This role develops and implements operational strategies, establishes performance expectations, leads cross functional initiatives, and ensures external manufacturing partners deliver products safely, efficiently, and in alignment with business objectives.

*This is a hybrid position with an expectation of 3 days per week on-site in Broomfield, CO.*

**This role may be responsible for, but not limited to:**

* Lead operational management of external manufacturing partners across assigned manufacturing networks.
* Oversee manufacturing qualification activities and support successful onboarding of new external manufacturing partners.
* Manage execution of network optimization initiatives, including transitions between manufacturing partners and facility rationalization activities.
* Establish and communicate operational performance expectations across Safety, Quality, Cost, and Delivery metrics.
* Monitor manufacturing partner performance and ensure corrective actions are identified, implemented, and sustained.
* Champion cross-functional project teams supporting network optimization, manufacturing transitions, and strategic initiatives.
* Partner with Procurement, PMO, Quality, R&D, Finance, Brand, Planning, Logistics, Customer Experience, and Milk Procurement teams to ensure successful project execution.
* Develop and execute strategies that improve manufacturing performance, service levels, and operational efficiency.
* Evaluate manufacturing capabilities and identify opportunities to optimize network performance.
* Ensure manufacturing partners operate in compliance with company standards, quality requirements, and operational expectations.
* Support supply continuity planning and mitigation activities associated with manufacturing risks and constraints.
* Analyze operational performance trends and develop recommendations for continuous improvement.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with external manufacturing partners.
* Lead initiatives that improve collaboration, communication, and execution across the external manufacturing network.
* Prepare and present operational performance updates, risks, and recommendations to leadership teams

*The base compensation range for this position is $125,000 - $140,000 commensurate with experience*.

**About You:**

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, Engineering, Manufacturing, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 7 years of experience in manufacturing, operations, supply chain, or related disciplines.
* Experience working within Consumer Packaged Goods, food, beverage, dairy, or manufacturing environments.
* Experience leading operational improvement initiatives and cross-functional projects.
* Experience managing suppliers, co-manufacturer, or contract manufacturing relationships.
* Experience developing and implementing operational strategies.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing, supply chain, and consumer packaged goods operations.
* Experience managing external manufacturing partners, suppliers, or co-manufacturers.
* Strong strategic planning and network optimization capabilities.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to evaluate complex operational challenges and implement effective solutions.
* Strong project management and cross-functional leadership capabilities.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Proven ability to develop and implement operational strategies and performance improvements.
* Strong leadership and organizational effectiveness skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience managing external manufacturing networks.
* Experience supporting network optimization and manufacturing transition initiatives.
* Experience leading large cross-functional business projects.
* Experience working with contract manufacturing and co-manufacturing environments.
* Experience supporting supply chain, logistics, planning, and procurement functions.
* Strong understanding of operational performance metrics and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Project management certification or formal project management training preferred.
* Ability to travel up to 25% or more as required.

card.description:
**Position:** Director – Operations 
**Location:** North Carolina/ South Carolina 
**Type:** Full-Time 
**Reports To:** CEO, ZetSol Energy

**Who We Are**

ZetSol Energy is the solar manufacturing and supply chain platform built to give North American solar developers, EPCs, utilities, and independent power producers a reliable, tariff-compliant alternative to fragmented overseas sourcing. The company is establishing a vertically integrated greenfield facility in Tuticorin, Tamil Nadu, producing silicon ingots, monocrystalline wafers, cells, and modules, including high-efficiency TOPCon and HJT technology, and pairs that manufacturing base with a full strategic sourcing, bill-of-materials management, quality audit, compliance, and logistics practice purpose-built for the US market.

ZetSol Energy is backed by Zetwerk, a global manufacturing platform valued at over $2.7 billion that already supplies solar piles, mechanical and structural components, and modules to leading US EPCs and asset owners, and whose 2022 acquisition of Unimacts strengthened its US industrial and solar manufacturing footprint. ZetSol Energy is the next chapter of that build-out: a dedicated US-facing commercial platform launching at a moment when American solar developers are actively searching for supply chain partners who can deliver both scale and certainty.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for an experienced operations leader to lead and scale ZetSol Energy's US operations, with overall responsibility for manufacturing, factory production, supply chain, logistics and sales operations.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in managing large-scale operations, with a strong background in Supply Chain Management (SCM), logistics and manufacturing, preferably within the renewable energy, solar or industrial sectors.

This individual will be responsible for overseeing factory production, managing end-to-end supply chain and logistics operations, and driving sales operations, including demand planning, order management and customer fulfilment in the US market.

The role will also involve building strong relationships with US government authorities, regulatory bodies, logistics partners and other key industry stakeholders, while ensuring operational efficiency, regulatory compliance and cost optimisation.

This is a key leadership position that will play an instrumental role in building and scaling ZetSol Energy's US operations, establishing robust operational processes and driving business growth in North America.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead and oversee end-to-end US operations for ZetSol Energy, covering manufacturing, supply chain, logistics and sales operations.

* Manage factory production operations, including production planning, capacity utilisation, quality, productivity and timely delivery.

* Drive end-to-end supply chain and logistics operations, including global sourcing, procurement, inventory management, import/export, customs clearance and distribution.

* Oversee sales operations, including demand planning, order management, customer fulfilment and coordination with commercial teams.

card.title: Senior Operations Director
card.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Operations Director to oversee business operations, strengthen financial performance, and improve organizational efficiency. This position is suited for a senior leader who understands how operational decisions affect profitability, resource allocation, and long-term business growth.

The Senior Operations Director will work closely with executive leadership, Finance, and department managers to establish operational priorities, improve internal processes, and ensure that business activities support financial and strategic objectives.

The ideal candidate brings extensive management experience, strong financial judgment, and a practical approach to solving complex operational challenges.

Key Responsibilities

Lead daily business operations and develop operational strategies that support organizational growth and financial performance.

Oversee departmental budgets, operating expenses, financial forecasts, and resource allocation in collaboration with Finance.

Monitor operational performance, profitability, productivity, and key financial indicators to identify opportunities for improvement.

Develop and implement processes that improve efficiency, reduce unnecessary costs, and strengthen organizational accountability.

Work with executive leadership to establish annual operating plans, business priorities, and performance objectives.

Evaluate financial reports, cash flow projections, operating margins, and profit and loss performance to support business decisions.

Coordinate cross-functional initiatives involving Finance, Human Resources, Business Development, and other operational departments.

Identify operational risks, improve internal controls, and support compliance with applicable business requirements.

Oversee vendor relationships, contract performance, procurement activities, and operational expenditures.

Introduce technology and automation solutions that improve reporting accuracy, workflow efficiency, and business performance.

Establish performance standards and management reporting procedures across operational teams.

Lead, mentor, and develop department managers while maintaining clear accountability for operational results.

Qualifications

15+ years of progressive experience in business operations, corporate management, financial operations, or related leadership positions.

At least 8 years of management experience overseeing operational teams, departmental budgets, or cross-functional business initiatives.

Strong understanding of financial management, budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and profit and loss analysis.

Demonstrated experience improving operational efficiency, managing business resources, and supporting organizational growth.

Experience developing operational strategies, managing performance indicators, and implementing process improvements.

Strong knowledge of financial reporting, cash flow management, business analytics, and operational risk assessment.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, enterprise management systems, and business intelligence tools.

Excellent organizational leadership, strategic planning, problem-solving, and executive communication skills.

A bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Operations Management, or a related discipline is required. An MBA or relevant advanced degree is preferred.

Ideal Candidate

You are an accomplished operations leader who understands the connection between financial discipline, operational efficiency, and business performance.

You have extensive experience managing complex operations, developing capable management teams, and improving business processes.

You are comfortable working with senior executives, evaluating financial information, and making decisions that affect organizational performance.

You bring sound financial judgment, strong leadership skills, and the ability to balance immediate operational needs with long-term business priorities.

You are focused on building efficient operations, maintaining financial accountability, and delivering measurable business results.

Pay: $206,200.00 - $256,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Relocation assistance
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Mount Laurel, NJ 08054

* Oversee project management, sales, and business development initiatives while maintaining a strong customer service focus.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and apply lean management principles to strengthen operational management and performance.

* Knowledge of strategic management, sales, customer service, and process improvement; experience applying lean management principles is preferred.
* Strong analytical and organizational skills, including proficiency in Excel data analysis.

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
